title: Green Brick Partners Announces the Promotion of Jed Dolson to Co-CEO
summary: The Green Brick Partners’ (NYSE: GRBK) Board of Directors today announced that as part of its long-term succession planning process, Jed Dolson, Chief Operating Officer and President, will be promoted to Co-Chief Executive Officer on October 15, 2026. Mr. Dolson joined Green Brick Partners in 2013 as the Head of Land Acquisition and Development. During his tenure, Mr. Dolson has served with increasing roles of responsibility, serving as President of the Texas Region, where he oversaw the operations of Green Brick’s Texas builders, EVP and Chief Operating Officer, where he led all builder and land acquisition and development functions, and most recently as President of Green Brick Partners.
